description: Free, read-only. A wallet's papertrade (BTC and ETH perps on HyperEVM) balance and open positions: market, side, leverage, margin, entry, current price, liquidation price and how far away it is, and what each would keep if closed now, after papertrade's impact haircut and 2% win fee. Answers "how are my positions doing?". Closing or opening needs the wallet's signature on papertax.xyz.
name: get_papertrade_positions
title: papertrade positions and what they keep
